purpose: Expand Wang Xizhi Teacher Memory and TC001 evidence through eligible remote modelbooks and letters while keeping prohibited religious works outside the calligraphy corpus.
tc001: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端

eligibleSources.note: Do not pre-download the complete album. Resolve individual sub-items and request only the smallest useful remote representation.
Treat as transmission evidence; retain sub-item identity instead of flattening the album into a font-like glyph pool.

eligibleSources.admission: research candidate pending institutional witness binding
eligibleSources.note: Do not admit web transcriptions or images as canonical records until tied to an institutional or otherwise authoritative witness.

excludedSources.reason: Buddhist/temple-related content conflicts with project collection policy.
excludedSources.status: blocked from canonical corpus, public collection, TC001 glyph sourcing and Project Hand evidence promotion
excludedSources.note: Search may encounter it because it contains several TC001 characters, but those hits must not improve coverage metrics.

researchRules: Search and inspect remotely; do not download whole works as a prerequisite.
Preserve work, sub-item, line/column and local phrase identity.
A remote IIIF/region or existing site transcoding response is sufficient for visual inspection when available.
Do not count a text-only web hit as a historical glyph hit.
Do not allow prohibited-work hits to resolve TC001 cells.
Modelbooks and later witnesses may teach structure and transmission; attribution/provenance must remain explicit.
Teacher Memory may learn from variation and counterexamples without turning every observed form into a canonical glyph.
